messages.subject: First D-RUG meeting of the quarter: Mon, 1/6, 3-5PM in Wickson 2120J
parts:
Hi all,

Happy New Year!  A reminder that this quarter we'll be meeting 3-5PM on Mondays, and our first meeting will be this Monday, Jan 6.  We will meet in Wickson 2120J.

No speaker this Monday, though we will have a quick organizational discussion about topics and speakers for the rest of the quarter.  Otherwise, bring whatever R project you are working on in 2014!

There will, as always, be cookies.

Noam

P.S. I've sent the following announcement out to various grad program listserv owners, but if it hadn't made it to your grad program in the next day or so, feel free to forward it on:

---
Subject: Davis R Users's Group winter meetings: Mon 3-5PM, Wickson 2120J
---

Davis R Users' Group work sessions will be held Mondays 3-5PM this quarter in Wickson 2120J.  

Do you use R in your classes or research?  Would you like to join a community of users in order to learn more and get support in your work?  Join the Davis R Users' Group!

D-RUG meetings are 2-hour open work sessions for R users of all levels to come to get and give support in R, statistics, and related topics.  Soe weeks we have ~30 minute presentations - either a tutorials on R topics or a members presenting a problem for feedback.  Weekly attendance is not required; come any week you have a question, a project to work on or are interested in the presentation topic (which will be announced a few days in advance).

For future announcements and R help via e-mail, sign up for the listserv: http://goo.gl/sLunu

Questions? Contact me at nmr...@ucdavis.edu.

I hope to see lots of you at our first session on Mon, Jan 6!

Sincerely,

Noam Ross
